entities.name: Protected substrate
observations: Decoded substrate contains a terminal O–Si protecting group and three Boc-type carbamate protecting groups.
Structure-based analysis identifies it as the main reactant in a TBAF-containing mixture.

entities.name: Desilylated alcohol
observations: Probable product is the substrate after replacing terminal O[Si](C)(C)(C)(C)C with O.

entities.name: TBAF desilylation
observations: Tetrabutylammonium fluoride with THF and water supports fluoride-mediated cleavage of a silyl ether.
Ethyl acetate is consistent with workup or extraction; no coupling, oxidation, or reduction reagent is evident.
